description:
Programme or Project Overview

The Islamic Development Bank operates one of the largest multilateral scholarship portfolios in the Muslim world, supporting students from its 57 member countries and Muslim communities in non-member countries. The programmes span undergraduate studies in science and technology, master's degrees, the Merit Scholarship for high-technology PhD and postdoctoral research, and dedicated schemes for students from least developed member countries. The 2027-28 round continues this structure with programme-specific calls published on the official IsDB scholarship portal.

Awards generally cover tuition fees, a monthly living allowance, health insurance and, for research degrees, thesis and scientific paper preparation support. Depending on the programme, scholars may also be eligible for computer and equipment allowances or internship placements linked to development institutions. IsDB scholars commit to returning knowledge to their home countries, and the alumni network now spans academia, government and industry across member states.

Choosing the right programme

Each IsDB scholarship stream has its own eligibility rules, degree levels, priority fields and application window, so applicants should identify the programme that matches their level and field before applying. The scholarship portal lists the currently open calls, quota tables and required documents, and all applications are submitted through the bank's online scholarship portal rather than by email. Typical documentation includes academic transcripts, admission evidence or university preferences, proof of citizenship from an eligible country, and a study or research plan aligned with the programme's development priorities.

Highlights

  • Merit Scholarships for high-technology PhD and postdoctoral research
  • Science and technology undergraduate awards
  • Master's degree scholarships for member-country students
  • Dedicated programmes for least developed member countries
  • Tuition coverage, monthly stipend and health insurance
  • Research and thesis support for doctoral scholars

About Islamic Development Bank (IsDB)

The Islamic Development Bank is a multilateral development bank headquartered in Jeddah, Saudi Arabia, serving its 57 member countries and Muslim communities worldwide. Its scholarship programmes, including the IsDB Merit Scholarship, the Science and Technology programme and awards for least developed member countries, have supported tens of thousands of students in STEM, medicine and development-related fields. Awards typically cover tuition fees, a monthly living allowance, health insurance and thesis or research support for the duration of study. Calls for applications are announced programme-wise on the IsDB scholarship portal, and applications are submitted online through the bank's scholarship portal.
